# Rarity Agency — DTC Performance Marketing & Creative Growth Lab

> Premier performance marketing agency and AI creative sprint lab for ambitious Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) ecommerce brands doing $1M to $10M+ in annual revenue. Built to scale brands against real net contribution margin and blended MER — eliminating platform ROAS vanity metrics.

## Quick Summary & Value Proposition
- **Core Offer**: A dedicated senior growth team (Senior Media Buyer, Creative Director, AI Prompt Engineers, Data Strategist, CRO Specialist) for less than the internal salary of a single media buyer.
- **Core Channels**: Meta Ads (Advantage+ & Custom Funnels), Google Performance Max (PMax), TikTok Ads, YouTube, and AI-Native UGC Video Ads.
- **Creative Volume**: 30+ bespoke, AI-accelerated high-converting creative angles, hooks, and UGC iterations delivered and tested every month.
- **Metric Focus**: Blended MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), Net Contribution Margin, First-Order CAC, and 60-Day Cohort LTV.
- **Client Results**: $15M+ in verified ad spend managed, consistently delivering 2.5x to 4.2x blended MER and scaling brands from $80K/mo to $400K+/mo.
- **Primary CTA**: Free 4-Step DTC Growth & Leak Audit (diagnoses ad spend waste, tracking drop-offs, creative fatigue, and unit economics).

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Performance Media Buying (Meta & Google PMax)
- Full-funnel account architecture (Consolidated Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns, Top-of-Funnel Sandboxing, Cost Cap / Bid Cap Scaling).
- Google Ads & Performance Max integration capturing high-intent search arbitrage and bottom-funnel retargeting.
- First-party pixel tracking and server-side Conversions API (CAPI) infrastructure.

### 2. AI-Native Creative Sprint Lab & UGC Production
- 30+ creative iterations per month: direct-response UGC hooks, founder stories, objection-busting comparison ads, high-energy unboxings, and motion graphics.
- Systematic testing protocol: Iterative hook variation testing (10+ hooks per winning visual body) to prevent ad fatigue and drop CPAs by 30-50%.

### 3. Unit Economics & Contribution Margin Modeling
- Alignment with brand P&L: real cash flow, allowable CAC thresholds, COGS, shipping, payment processor fees, and repeat purchase rates.
- Elimination of in-platform blended ROAS illusions in favor of true Blended MER and bank-deposit profit.

### 4. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Landers
- Custom high-converting advertorials, listicles, comparison pages, and quiz funnels designed specifically for paid traffic.

## Ideal Client Profile (ICP)
- **Business Model**: DTC Ecommerce / Shopify / Shopify Plus brands.
- **Revenue**: $1M to $10M+ in annual revenue ($80k to $800k/month).
- **Ad Spend**: $20k to $150k+/month on Meta and Google.
- **Pain Points**: Stuck on the Meta ROAS rollercoaster, creative fatigue, rising CAC, agency lack of communication, burning cash on junior media buyers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What makes Rarity Agency different from traditional agencies?
Traditional agencies assign junior media buyers juggling 15+ accounts, report on vanity platform ROAS, and produce slow creative. Rarity gives you direct access to senior operators, produces 30+ AI creative iterations monthly, and optimizes exclusively for bank-deposit contribution margin.

### How does the Free Growth Audit work?
In a 30-minute diagnostic session, senior growth strategists inspect your Meta & Google ad accounts, attribution data, creative fatigue metrics, and cohort retention to uncover exact revenue leaks and wasted ad spend.

### Where can I book an audit?
Direct audit calendar: [https://rarityagency.com/free-audit](https://rarityagency.com/free-audit)
